rules.title: San Francisco ban on algorithmic rent-setting tools
rules.requirement: Property owners and managers may not use algorithm-based tools that recommend or set rental prices.
rules.coverage_conditions: Property owners and managers of rental housing in San Francisco.
rules.citation: San Francisco Board of Supervisors ordinance (July 2024); official citation not given in this document
rules.quoted_span:
In July 2024, the San Francisco Board of Supervisors approved 
legislation to ban property owners and managers from using algorithm-based tools that recommend 
or set rental prices.
rules.conflict_note: Secondary mention in a Los Angeles council motion; the document states only Board approval in July 2024 and gives no effective date, signing date, or code citation. Status as in force on 2026-10-01 is inferred, not confirmed by this document.
